Title: Create a new order with customer details, items, measurements, and financial amounts
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists. An item with ID 1 (e.g., 'Formal Shirt') exists.
Expected Result:
HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {
  "orderId": <non-null number>,
  "shopName": "<shop name>",
  "itemName": "Formal Shirt",
  "itemCount": 1,
  "totalAmount": 1500.00,
  "paidAmount": 500.00,
  "dueAmount": 1000.00,
  "orderDate": "2023-12-01",
  "trialDate": "2023-12-15",
  "deliveryDate": "2023-12-20",
  "customerName": "John Doe",
  "customerPhone": "5551234567"
}

Title: Create a new order with multiple items and measurement groups matching item quantity
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists. Items with ID 1 (e.g., 'Formal Shirt') and ID 2 (e.g., 'Trousers') exist.
Expected Result:
HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {
  "orderId": <non-null number>,
  "shopName": "<shop name>",
  "itemName": "Formal Shirt, Trousers",
  "itemCount": 3,
  "totalAmount": 3000.00,
  "paidAmount": 1000.00,
  "dueAmount": 2000.00,
  "orderDate": "2023-12-02",
  "trialDate": "2023-12-16",
  "deliveryDate": "2023-12-22",
  "customerName": "Jane Smith",
  "customerPhone": "5559876543"
}

Title: Create a new order with mismatched item quantity and measurement groups (error case)
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists. An item with ID 1 (e.g., 'Formal Shirt') exists.
Expected Result: HTTP 400 Bad Request response with an error message: "Item count and number of measurement groups must match for item ID: 1".

Title: Create a new order with item-level photo and verify it is included in the response
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists. An item with ID 1 (e.g., 'Formal Shirt') exists.
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the order summary. The item photo URL is stored and retrievable (if GET order details API is available, it should include the photo URL).

Title: Verify that order creation rejects malformed or excessively large measurement values to prevent overflow or injection
Preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized to create orders for the shop
Expected Result: 1. The API responds with HTTP status 400 (Bad Request) and an error message indicating invalid measurement value (e.g., 'Measurement value exceeds allowed limit'). 2. The API responds with HTTP status 400 (Bad Request) and an error message indicating invalid measurement value (e.g., 'Measurement value must be a positive number').

Title: Verify that order creation enforces validation on the number of measurement groups matching item quantity
Preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized to create orders for the shop
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 400 (Bad Request) and an error message indicating that the number of measurement groups must match the item quantity (e.g., 'Item count and number of measurement groups must match for item ID: 1').

Title: Verify that order creation rejects path traversal sequences in photo URLs to prevent unauthorized file access
Preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized to create orders for the shop
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 400 (Bad Request) and an error message indicating invalid photo URL (e.g., 'Invalid photo URL format').

Title: Verify that order creation does not expose sensitive customer data in the response
Preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized to create orders for the shop
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 200 (OK) and a response body containing only non-sensitive fields (e.g., orderId, shopName, itemName, itemCount, totalAmount, paidAmount, dueAmount, orderDate, trialDate, deliveryDate, customerName, customerPhone). No raw storage paths, internal IDs, or other sensitive data is exposed.

Title: Verify that order creation rejects invalid date formats to prevent injection or parsing errors
Preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized to create orders for the shop
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 400 (Bad Request) and an error message indicating invalid date format (e.g., 'Invalid date format for trialDate').

Title: Verify that order creation enforces proper validation on monetary amounts (e.g., negative values, non-numeric input)
Preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized to create orders for the shop
Expected Result: 1. The API responds with HTTP status 400 (Bad Request) and an error message indicating invalid totalAmount (e.g., 'Total amount must be a positive value'). 2. The API responds with HTTP status 400 (Bad Request) and an error message indicating invalid totalAmount (e.g., 'Total amount must be a numeric value').
